items: You can now see what's been done to her: while she's slowed, stars circle her head and her steps drag; while she's confused, a spiral turns over her head; thrown hard, she skids in a trail of dust. She's tinted with the attacker's colour and each has its own sound
Each attack's warning shape on the ground is now in its attacker's own colour (green for venom, amber for earth, icy blue for frost...) instead of all red, as a trial
